seo.title: Allergies: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment | Doctors Hub
seo.description: Learn about Allergies — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Allergies are exaggerated immune responses to harmless substances (pollen, dust, food, drugs). Allergic rhinitis and food allergies are increasingly recognised in urban India.
symptoms: Swelling of lips or face in food allergy
riskFactors: Family history of asthma or eczema
Food allergen exposure in sensitised individuals
diagnosis: Skin prick or specific IgE testing
Elimination diet under supervision for food allergy
prevention: Controlled introduction of allergens in infants per paediatric guidance

faqs.question: What causes Allergies?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Allergies curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.

emergencySigns: Dizziness or collapse after allergen exposure
Use epinephrine and call emergency services if anaphylaxis suspected
